title: IR Studio
summary: 38 kHz IR studio with PulseNet-IR ML, Smart AC, universal probe & .ir lab
description: IR Studio is a pure-Go 38 kHz Infrared lab for CardputerZero (/dev/lirc*). Capture and decode NEC, Samsung32, RC5, RC6, SIRC, Kaseikyo and RAW frames; classify 24 real IR protocols and match remotes via 32D SupCon k-NN with embedded INT8 PulseNet-IR; rescue noisy/AGC-stretched signals with 1D K-Means and neural 1D-UNet denoising; control 6 AC brands with checksummed state frames; run TV-B-Gone/TV-Service probes, macros, Pronto Hex import/export, PWM flicker/RPM optical lab tools, and an opt-in stdio MCP server.
